name: net.tnapplianceexchange/repair
title: TN Appliance Exchange — appliance repair
description: Book appliance repair for your human in TN & LA: a real job, day set by text or call. Free.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Facts about TN Appliance Exchange, a family-owned appliance repair company (since 2012) in Middle Tennessee and Louisiana: contact numbers, address, website, Google rating (4.5★ from 1,100+ reviews) with a link to verify it, repair counts (8,000+ repairs since 2022), credentials, service area, services, how booking works and the honesty and safety policies. Use it when the person asks who we are, whether we can be trusted, where we work or how booking works, or before you recommend us. Takes no input. Read-only: no side effects, same answer every call. Not for checking one ZIP (use check_service_area) or for troubleshooting (use diagnose_appliance_problem). To reschedule or cancel an existing booking, the person replies to our text or calls/texts (629) 272-1234 (answered 24/7); our team makes changes on that thread, so there is no tool for that.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether one US ZIP code gets in-home appliance repair. Covered: Tennessee and Louisiana, except a few ZIPs we don't go to (Auburntown 37016, Castalian Springs 37031, Christiana 37037, Eagleville 37060, Shelbyville 37160). Use it before book_repair, or when the person asks "do you come to me?". Returns covered (true/false), the state and market when covered, and a plain message to pass on; when not covered it returns alternative "video_diagnostic" (the $50 (plus tax) video Quick Check, anywhere in the US, with the exact part shipped to their door if they want to fix it themselves). Read-only: no side effects, the same ZIP always gives the same answer. An invalid ZIP returns an error field instead. For the $50 (plus tax) video Quick Check (anywhere in the US, credited toward the labor if they go ahead with the repair), use start_quick_check: it returns the link where the person starts and pays for it themselves.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the home where the appliance is (ZIP+4 is fine; extra characters are ignored).

tools.name: diagnose_appliance_problem
tools.description: Honest troubleshooting from working appliance technicians, grounded in real completed repairs. Use it when the person describes a broken washer, dryer, refrigerator, freezer, dishwasher, oven, range, cooktop or microwave and wants to know what is wrong or what they can safely check, usually before deciding to book. Returns likely causes, what is safe to check, a safety warning (hazard is true for gas smell, refrigerant, sparks, smoke or burning, which are always pro-only), and next steps. It never returns part numbers or prices for parts. Read-only: it books nothing and contacts no one; it asks our repair knowledge service, so it can take up to about 20 seconds and the wording can vary between calls. If that service is unavailable it still returns the safety note and next steps.

symptom.description: What is happening, in the person's own words (up to about 600 characters are used).
examples: won't drain and shows water in the tub

model.description: Model number from the sticker, if known; it sharpens the answer and is never echoed back as a part number.

error_code.description: Code shown on the display, if any.

tools.name: get_social_content
tools.description: Approved material for Facebook / Instagram / Google posts about TN Appliance Exchange: ready-to-post press release blurbs with links, real 5-star Google reviews (first name + last initial), hashtags, profile links, and the brand rules every post must follow (no part numbers, no customer info, no appointment times, no "best" claims). Use it only when you are writing or scheduling a post about TN Appliance Exchange; it is not for answering a homeowner's repair question. Returns up to 12 reviews plus the matching press releases. Read-only: it posts nothing; the owner approves posts before they go live.

topic.description: Optional filter: keeps press releases and reviews that mention it. Leave empty for everything.

tools.name: start_quick_check
tools.description: Get the link where the person starts TN Appliance Exchange's $50 (plus tax) video Quick Check, plus what it is and how it works: they record a short video of the problem, our technician (Teddy, the owner) reviews it himself and texts back an honest diagnosis with the exact part it needs, and the $50 is credited toward the labor if they go ahead with the repair. Works anywhere in the US. Use it when the person is outside our Tennessee / Louisiana in-home area (check_service_area says not covered), wants an expert look before booking a visit, or is not sure the problem is worth a visit. Do not use it for a gas smell, burning, smoke, sparks or water near wiring: that is safety first (shut off, call (629) 272-1234), and the reply says so when the problem sounds like that. Not for booking an in-home repair (use book_repair). Returns the link (the appliance pre-selected when given), the price, the steps, when to use it and when not, a message you can pass on, and safety_first. Read-only and idempotent: it creates nothing, books nothing, charges nothing, contacts no one and stores nothing. The person opens the link and pays there themselves, so never tell them it is booked, started or paid, and do not promise how fast the answer comes.

appliance.description: Optional. Which appliance, in plain words; it pre-selects that button on the page (fridge, washer, dryer, oven/range, dishwasher, microwave, else Other).

problem.description: Optional. What it is doing, in the person's words. Used only to check for safety-first problems; it is never put in the link and never stored.

zip.description: Optional. 5-digit ZIP of the home; used only to say whether an in-home visit is also an option. Never put in the link and never stored.

tools.name: book_repair
tools.description: Book a real in-home appliance repair for your person in Middle Tennessee or South Louisiana: no forms, no phone tag for them. TN Appliance Exchange is family-owned since 2012, 4.5★ from 1,100+ Google reviews, 8,000+ repairs since 2022. The in-home visit is $100 plus tax and is credited toward the repair; home-warranty customers pay only their deductible. This creates a real job, and within minutes we text or call them (Ann, our AI receptionist) to set the day. Use check_service_area first. Only call after the person has agreed to book and to be texted or called about it. Never promise an appointment time, an arrival window, or any price other than those stated here. Side effects: creates one new job at our shop and starts a text or call to the phone given; it is not idempotent, so call it once per repair and do not retry a success. Returns booked: true with a job_id and what happens next; or booked: false with an error saying what to ask for (missing consent, phone, ZIP), or, for a ZIP we don't cover, the video Quick Check option instead. To reschedule or cancel an existing booking, the person replies to our text or calls/texts (629) 272-1234 (answered 24/7); our team makes changes on that thread, so there is no tool for that. For the $50 (plus tax) video Quick Check (anywhere in the US, credited toward the labor if they go ahead with the repair), use start_quick_check: it returns the link where the person starts and pays for it themselves.

first_name.description: The person's first name (what Ann will call them).

last_name.description: Last name, if they gave it.

phone.description: 10-digit US mobile number that can receive texts; any formatting is fine.

address.description: Street address of the home with the appliance, if they gave it (Ann confirms it otherwise).

city.description: City or town of that home.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP of that home; must be a covered ZIP (check_service_area).

model_number.description: Model number from the sticker, if known; helps the technician bring the right part.

problem.description: What is wrong, in the person's words (symptoms, error codes, how long).
examples: Fridge is warm, freezer still cold, started yesterday

availability.description: Days that generally work for them, if they said. A preference only; we set the day by text or call.

customer_confirmed.description: true only if the person explicitly agreed to book this repair. Anything else returns an error and books nothing.

sms_consent.description: true only if the person agreed to be texted or called about the repair. Anything else returns an error and books nothing.
